title: A Composition Theorem for Binomially Weighted Averages
summary: We study binomially weighted summation methods given by \[ (x_n)_{n\in \mathbb{N}} \mapsto \left(\sum_{k=0}^n\binom{n}{k}r^k(1-r)^{n-k}x_k\right)_{n\in \mathbb{N}} \] for $r\in (0,1)$, and their behavior under composition with summation methods of the form \[ (x_n)_{n\in \mathbb{N}} \mapsto \left(\sum_{k=0}^nλ_k x_{n-k}\right)_{n\in \mathbb{N}}. \] Our main result shows that if the binomially weighted averages of a sequence $(x_n)_{n\in \mathbb{N}}$ converge to a limit then the binomially weighted averages of the sequence $\left(\sum_{k=0}^nλ_kx_{n-k}\right)_{n\in \mathbb{N}}$ converge to…
